oracle: bron420.zip x64/bregonig.dll, captured before archive deletion
behavior: Product BMatchW/BSubstW/BMatchExW/BSubstExW results must match oracle-corpus.json.

pe.exports: Exact name set from oracle-pe.json. Calling convention is cdecl, proven by the corpus.
pe.dllCharacteristics: Product must keep DYNAMICBASE and NX_COMPAT. HIGHENTROPYVA is an allowed extra hardening bit.
pe.imports: KERNEL32.dll is required. VCRUNTIME*/ucrtbase*/api-ms-win-crt-* are allowed because the product CRT is the vcpkg dynamic CRT; the historical oracle linked CRT statically. onigmo.dll is forbidden because Onigmo is statically linked.

match-unicode-hiragana: The historical DLL does not treat \\uHHHH inside a class as a Unicode code point. Frozen as a miss.
match-crlf: A bare /a$/m does not match CR before LF on the historical DLL. Frozen as a miss.
subst-empty-result: outp is null when substitution produces an empty string (bregonig Issue #1). Frozen.
timeout: The public API has no bounded-timeout entry. Pathological cases must complete on small inputs without crashing.
